properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Package Manager Install Hook Spawns Scripting Interpreter Then Touches Credential Files or Egresses Off-Registry
properties.description:
Detects the joint pattern shared across the May 2026 npm/PyPI/Packagist compromise wave: a package-manager process (npm/yarn/pnpm/pip/uv/poetry/composer/php) spawns a generic scripting interpreter (node/python/sh/bash/powershell/curl/wget) as part of a postinstall/setup.py hook, and that child either reads developer credential material (.npmrc, .pypirc, ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, .env, GH_TOKEN-bearing files) or beacons to a non-registry public destination within a 5-minute window on the same host. This matters this fortnight because TeamPCP's self-spreading 'Mini Shai-Hulud' worm hit @tanstack ('TanStack Npm Packages Compromised Inside The Mini Shai Hulud Supply Chain Attack', 'TeamPCP's Mini Shai-Hulud Is Back') and @beproduct/nestjs-auth, Microsoft's durabletask PyPI was trojanised ('The AntV Supply Chain Campaign Expands'), node-ipc, guardrails-ai==0.10.1 (CVE-2026-45758), @cap-js/sqlite|postgres|db-service (CVE-2026-46421), and the Laravel-Lang Composer namespace ('Laravel-Lang Supply Chain Advisory', 'Every Tag…Rewritten', 'Supply Chain Attack Targets Laravel-Lang') were all compromised in a 14-day window — and the '5 Supply Chain Attacks in 48 Hours' write-up plus the npm 2FA-gating response confirm this is the dominant fortnightly TTP. The detection spans install (package hook drops/runs payload), credential-access (T1552.001 / T1555 / T1539), and exfil/C2 (T1041 / T1071) — the IOCs (getsession.org, masscan.cloud, azurestaticprovider.net, flipboxstudio.info, git-tanstack.com, m-kosche.com) rotate package-by-package but the chain is invariant. It fires when a developer or CI runner installs a package and the install lifecycle script reaches outside the registry, including first-install on dev laptops and `npm ci`/`pip install -r`/`composer update` in pipelines. It deliberately does NOT fire on package managers contacting only registry/CDN destinations (registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org, packagist.org, codeload.github.com, ghcr.io), on machine-account contexts, or on interpreter spawns that lack the package-manager parent ancestry.

Rationale: Every article in scope describes the same chain — a package-ecosystem install runs a lifecycle hook that drops to a generic interpreter, scrapes credential material from well-known dotfile paths, and beacons to attacker-controlled infrastructure that is by definition not the language's package registry. By correlating package-manager-parent → interpreter-child against (credential file touch OR non-registry public egress) within 5 minutes on the same host, the rule catches Mini Shai-Hulud (npm), durabletask/guardrails-ai (PyPI), @cap-js (npm), node-ipc (npm), and Laravel-Lang (Composer/Packagist) without depending on any of their rotating domains, hashes, or package names.
properties.query:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowSeconds = 300;
let PkgMgrs = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe","poetry.exe","uv.exe","composer.phar","composer","php.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe"]);
let Interpreters = dynamic(["node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash","dash","zsh","curl.exe","wget.exe"]);
let TrustedRegistries = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","packagist.org","repo.packagist.org","codeload.github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","ghcr.io","raw.githubusercontent.com"]);
let Children = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ParentFile = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
    | extend ChildFile  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
    | where ParentFile in (PkgMgrs)
    | where ChildFile  in (Interpreters)
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ChildTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              ParentFile, ChildFile, ChildCmd=CommandLine, ChildPid=NewProcessId;
let SysmonChildren = Event
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 1
    | extend ed = parse_xml(EventData)
    | extend ParentImage = tolower(tostring(ed.DataItem.EventData.Data[20]["#text"]))
    | extend Image       = tolower(tostring(ed.DataItem.EventData.Data[4]["#text"]))
    | extend ParentFile  = tostring(split(ParentImage,"\\")[-1])
    | extend ChildFile   = tostring(split(Image,"\\")[-1])
    | where ParentFile in (PkgMgrs)
    | where ChildFile  in (Interpreters)
    | project ChildTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName=tostring(ed.DataItem.EventData.Data[12]["#text"]),
              ParentFile, ChildFile,
              ChildCmd=tostring(ed.DataItem.EventData.Data[10]["#text"]),
              ChildPid=tostring(ed.DataItem.EventData.Data[3]["#text"]);
let AllChildren = union Children, SysmonChildren;
let Net = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DeviceAction !in~ ("blocked","denied","dropped")
    | where isnotempty(DestinationHostName) or isnotempty(DestinationIP)
    | extend Host = tolower(DestinationHostName)
    | where not(Host has_any (TrustedRegistries))
    | project NetTime=TimeGenerated, Computer=DeviceName,
              Egress=strcat(DestinationHostName," ",DestinationIP,":",tostring(DestinationPort));
AllChildren
| join kind=inner Net on Computer
| where NetTime between (ChildTime .. ChildTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| summarize Egresses=make_set(Egress, 20),
            FirstChild=min(ChildTime),
            LastEgress=max(NetTime)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentFile, ChildFile, ChildCmd
| order by FirstChild desc
